prompt: Bootstrap a new Effectstream template called `my-evm-rooms` from scratch. EVM-only (Hardhat local for dev, no mainnet yet), no batcher, no frontend, no tests — just the skeleton that boots with `bun run dev`. State machine: one custom action `createRoom(roomName: string up to 32 chars, maxPlayers: number 2-8)` that writes to a `rooms` table. Also Dockerfile. Save to /tmp/eval-runs/iter-1/eval-new-evm-minimal/{with,without}/template/.
